learning_outcomes.text: Ability to work efficiently in intra-disciplinary teams.
Ability to communicate effectively orally and in written; knowledge of at least one foreign language; writing reports effectively and understanding of written reports.
Awareness of the necessity of lifelong learning; the ability to access information, monitor developments in science and technology, and renew him/herself constantly.

syllabus_topics: Separation Processes and the Place of Adsorption in Separation Processes, Transport Phenomena in Porous Solids
Diffusion and Determination of Effective Diffusion Constant
